news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
news.summary: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

news.title: Bitcoin, ether get CFTC staff nod for expense requirements, Ethereum Foundation doubles security team, and more
news.summary: In today's newsletter, bitcoin, ether gain recognition under CFTC financial requirements; Ethereum Foundation doubles security team as AI risks grow; and more.

news.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
news.summary: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

news.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
news.summary: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.

news.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
news.summary: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

news.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges against Kalshi after platform halts operations
news.summary: AG Derek Brown's office filed a motion Monday to drop the charges without prejudice, meaning it can refile if Kalshi returns.

news.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
news.summary: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

news.title: New York senator proposes 10% tax on prediction market fees to fund universal pre-K
news.summary: Proceeds from the 10% tax would be channeled to a new fund for universal pre-kindergarten for children ages 2 to 4.

news.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
news.summary: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

news.title: Hackers breach CIA intelligence network in latest US cyberattack
news.summary: The reported breach follows cyber incidents involving the FBI, Department of Homeland Security and Department of Agriculture.

news.title: Bitcoin miner CleanSpark swings to $987 million annual loss as BTC production declines
news.summary: CleanSpark's annual revenue fell 25% as the bitcoin miner continues to shift toward AI infrastructure.

news.summary: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.

news.title: SEC staff gives Molecule no-action relief for scientific research tokens
news.summary: SEC staff said it would not recommend an enforcement action against Molecule for its utility tokens that allow people to support research.

news.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
news.summary: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.

news.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
news.summary: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.

news.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years

news.title: Payward’s Krak plans early 2027 launch of US credit cards with bitcoin cashback, including one secured by USDC
news.summary: Krak has opened a waitlist for two U.S. credit card products, including a secured card that uses USDC as collateral.

news.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry

news.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
news.summary: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

news.title: Rep. Raskin probes Trump Jr.’s firm’s investments into Polymarket and Juul over ‘suspiciously well-timed government favors’
news.summary: Rep. Raskin has expanded his investigation into 1789 Capital, probing potential links between investments in companies such as Polymarket.

news.title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
news.summary: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.

news.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price

news.title: Robinhood co-leads $5 million seed round for onchain trading platform Rialto
news.summary: Rialto has processed more than $600 million in spot trading volume across its app and Swap API since launching publicly in July, Can said.

news.title: Ansem denies involvement in $2.57 million wallet drain; Black Bull creator coin plummets 55%

news.title: Europol operation involving Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis traces more than $28.5 million in crypto behind illegal streaming services
news.summary: Europol traced more than €26 million ($28.5 million) in crypto transactions during an investigation into illegal IPTV services.

news.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
news.summary: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

news.title: 'AI trade never died': Traders see room for market recovery, but bitcoin's participation is another story
news.summary: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

news.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sells $43.8 million in ETH to cut Aave debt, CEO says ‘we do not take this lightly’
news.summary: Nasdaq-listed BTCS sold 27,300 ETH during Friday's crypto rout to slash decentralized debt and curb collateral liquidation risk.

news.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
news.summary: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

news.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
news.summary: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

news.title: Crypto Market Structure Basics
news.summary: Crypto Market Structure 101 explains how crypto markets work for beginners. It covers centralized and decentralized exchanges, trading pairs and settlement, order types, leverage and perpetual futures, market makers, key market players, and crypto fundraising.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs see another $570 million in net outflows as November total nears $5 billion and BTC dips below $60K
news.summary: BlackRock's IBIT bitcoin exchange-traded fund again led the outflows, with $509.3 million exiting the fund on Monday.

news.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
news.summary: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

news.title: XRP Ledger DEX volume hits 4.51 million XRP a day in Q3 as big traders take over: Evernorth
news.summary: XRP Ledger DEX order-book volume averaged 4.51M XRP a day in Q3, Evernorth says, as top accounts drove 65% of trading and RLUSD rose 74%.

news.title: Ledn brings US business onshore with account to hold, swap and borrow against bitcoin
news.summary: Ledn's new U.S. custody account lets customers hold bitcoin, gold, stablecoins and dollars, swap with no trading fees and borrow against bitcoin without selling.

news.title: Neuberger Berman’s HINC fund brings high-yield credit to Aave’s institutional lending platform
news.summary: Neuberger Berman's tokenized high-yield fund HINC launches on Aave Horizon, letting eligible investors borrow USDC, GHO and RLUSD against it.

news.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
news.summary: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

news.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
news.summary: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

news.title: BlackRock opens tokenized money market fund with $100 million in assets to Hong Kong investors
news.summary: BlackRock has launched and opened its HKD Digital Liquidity Fund to retail and institutional investors in Hong Kong.

news.title: Grayscale calls Bitcoin ‘oversold’ at $62K but warns of AI risks
news.summary: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s bear market was its longest on record at 411 days and counting, though the 56% drop was the smallest percentage decline.

news.title: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked as $2 million in memecoins were sold
news.summary: Ansem suspects someone broke into his account on Bullpen, the trading terminal he co-founded, where the wallet's private key had been imported.

news.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London

news.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
news.summary: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team, calls AI a ‘more urgent risk’ than quantum
news.summary: The Ethereum Foundation is expanding its security resources as advances in AI raise new concerns about cryptography and software security.

news.title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
news.summary: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

news.title: Bitcoin hands back Monday's Nvidia-driven gains, liquidations triple
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) has dropped 2.2% since midnight UTC to around $59,900, giving back Monday's jump and lagging the stock market's rebound from last week's selloff.

news.title: South Korea’s draft crypto bill sets path for domestic ICOs while capping exchange shareholder stakes at 20%
news.summary: The draft will now head to the legislature, where lawmakers will debate it and potentially merge it with competing proposals.

news.title: Bitcoin’s drop to $55,000 left a record 11.6 million BTC underwater
news.summary: Bitcoin’s supply in profit fell below its 2022 FTX collapse low, while entities holding 100 to 10,000 BTC continued to accumulate.

news.title: U.S. seeks $1.1 billion seized in Binance hack as North Korean funds keep moving
news.summary: U.S. seeks to recover $1.1 billion in frozen USDC as billions more from the Binance hack remain unaccounted for.

news.title: BTCS sells more than half its ether to repay $43.8 million in Aave debt
news.summary: The firm's DeFi business, Imperium, temporarily pulled out of liquidity pools after generating $3.5 million in Q3 revenue.

news.title: South Korea regulator backs bank-controlled stablecoins after months of dispute
news.summary: Fintech firms could lead stablecoin ventures, but banks would need to own more than half of any issuer.

news.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as rally on Jensen Huang’s Nvidia return fades
news.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1% after the index surged on Monday, while the Dollar Index held above 104, its highest level since March 2025.

news.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
news.summary: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
news.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

news.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
news.summary: The independent macro research company warns the Bitcoin sell-off may not have yet run its course.

news.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
news.summary: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
news.summary: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

news.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
news.summary: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

news.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
news.summary: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

news.title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
news.summary: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

news.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
news.summary: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

news.title: Bitcoin rebound already losing steam as AI trade returns with a bang
news.summary: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

news.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
news.summary: ProShares' rival CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF (KRYP) holds $1.81 million in assets nearly 10 months post-launch.

news.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
news.summary: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

news.title: Eric Trump-backed American Bitcoin secures $150 million loan against its bitcoin
news.summary: The Nasdaq-listed crypto miner can borrow without selling its reserves or issuing new shares, but falling BTC prices could force it to pledge more collateral.
